trust_decision.summary: Only a user holding formie-manageFormIntegrations (globally or for the posted form's uid) may apply form-level integration settings, and only allowlisted non-sensitive setting keys may be merged onto the stored integration; enforced in IntegrationsController::actionFormSettings before setAttributes()/getFormSettings(false).

landing_point.why: The advisory names the integrations/form-settings action; this is the action that reads the caller's integration handle and settings and applies them to a stored integration before an outbound fetch, and it has no permission check of its own (only the login gate from $allowAnonymous).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The form-save endpoint already requires formie-editForms or formie-manageForm:<uid>, and integrations are just one section of the form config the editor legitimately saves; the advisory names the integrations/form-settings action, not form save.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The integrations tab posts the whole saved per-form integration settings object back and then renders mapping/object pickers from the response (mapTo*, *FieldMapping, *Id, sendEmailCampaign, attachFiles must still be merged and the stored endpoint/credentials must still be used). A blanket reject-all-settings or permission-only fix breaks mapping preview, while re-allowing url/headers/httpAuth reopens the SSRF.

O6_input_shapes: settings as an array versus a scalar/string: only arrays are processed now (is_array($settings)), a string previously went straight into Yii setAttributes()
settings keys that are not strings are skipped
sensitive attribute names matched by substring: key, secret, token, password, url, domain, uri, host, credential, auth
allowed suffixes mapTo* and *FieldMapping and *Id, plus the literals sendEmailCampaign and attachFiles (default-deny)
formId sent as a numeric string is cast to int; missing/zero formId and non-existent form id now 400 instead of proceeding
unknown integration handle now 400s instead of dereferencing a null integration
CP request versus front-end request: requireCpRequest() rejects non-CP requests

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST formie/integrations/check-connection takes any global integration id and calls checkConnection(false), which performs an outbound HTTP request to the stored endpoint with the stored credentials; no permission check and no form scoping
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is a read-only 'test connection' probe that only uses stored settings, not caller-supplied ones, so it reads as a different feature from the advisory's settings-injection sink.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same controller, 23 lines below the landing action; sink in src/base/Integration.php:356-396

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST formie/integrations/save-integration writes any integration type and its settings (including WebRequest url, headers, httpAuth) into project config with no permission check, feeding the same stored integration that later fetches/delivers
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It writes project config, which Craft normally restricts via allowAdminChanges, and the settings form is an admin-side screen, so the missing permission looks like a deployment assumption rather than the advisory's bug.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same controller, 39 lines above the landing action; persistence in src/services/Integrations.php:404-445

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST formie/integrations/connect runs OAuth connect/callback for any global integration id, making an outbound request with the integration's stored client credentials and session state, with no permission check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is an OAuth redirect helper rather than a settings endpoint and only touches stored credentials, so it is easy to call a separate concern.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same controller, ~55 lines below the landing action; sink in src/base/Integration.php:522-537

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second settings-write route that persists settings.integrations with only form-edit permission
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The form edit UI already submits settings[integrations][handle][url]/[enabled], and buildFormFromPost merges them, so a maintainer adding another integration field here is entirely natural.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a plugin-settings save that mass-assigns request settings, a natural host for a 'test/default integration' sibling
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already does setAttributes($request->getParam('settings'), false) with no filtering, the same idiom the fix had to remove from IntegrationsController.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an anonymous outbound-HTTP proxy action with caller-supplied endpoint params
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Maintainers already wrote an outbound-call endpoint outside the CP, so a second integration-preview endpoint copied from this shape is plausible.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a GraphQL settings surface for integration settings (allowedGqlSettings already aliases webhook to url)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Formie exposes integration settings to GraphQL, so an allowedGqlSettings-style allowlist is where a maintainer would next add a URL-bearing attribute.

O9_family: CWE-862 missing authorization / CWE-915 mass assignment leading to CWE-918 SSRF and exfiltration of stored integration credentials

O10_build.toolchain: PHP ^8.0.2 with Composer; Craft CMS ^4.3.2 plugin (Craft install + migrations required; Guzzle for the integration HTTP calls)
services: a controllable HTTP endpoint for the SSRF sink (can be local)
O10_build.project_tests: none in the repo: no tests directory and no phpunit/codeception config in composer.json or the tree; the fix diff adds no tests

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add the formie-manageFormIntegrations check and a settings allowlist to actionFormSettings only, leaving check-connection, save-integration, OAuth connect and the form-save hydration path that stores the same settings untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: Note on the two fix commits, not a pursuit of another issue: dde7799 checks formie-showFormIntegrations, which is not registered anywhere in this pinned tree (src/Formie.php:222-280); 6735fe4 uses the registered formie-manageFormIntegrations and its base blob (7a56b165) matches the pinned file, so 6735fe4 is the fix that applies here.
